config.description: a shape-verify-config file (its `utility` section drives the utility gate)

holdout.description: real rows that were not given to the generator, as a data file or a folder with one file per table: turns on the membership-inference test

manifest.description: the run manifest file of the generation: adds its reproducibility tuple and dataset id

output.description: a file to also write the card to, as JSON

real.description: the real data: a data file, or a folder with one file per table

require.description: sections that must have run: one that was not run fails the card

synthetic.description: the synthetic data: a data file, or a folder with one file per table

tiers.description: the fidelity tiers to run, of 1 and 2 (default 1 and 2)

async.description: for a command that can run as a job: return a job id at once and run in the background

include_raw_values.description: return raw values (minimum, maximum, category values, offending values) even for classified columns; off by default

max_inline_bytes.description: a result part larger than this is written to a file and returned as a reference
